subject.title: improve(imessage): manage imsg setup and plugin skill ownership

question: Should the imsg skill move from always-bundled skills/imsg to plugin-scoped extensions/imessage/skills even though plugin skills publish only when the iMessage plugin is activated?
rationale: The plugin-owned shape matches newer channel-plugin patterns, but it intentionally changes skill availability and stale-session repair behavior for existing users, so automation should not decide the product contract.

options.title: Accept plugin-scoped imsg after fixes
options.body: Keep the ownership move, require the docs mismatch and macOS setup proof to be fixed, and treat inactive-plugin skill loss as intended behavior.

options.title: Preserve always-available imsg
options.body: Keep or reintroduce an always-bundled compatibility skill until OpenClaw has an explicit migration or always-on channel-skill contract.

options.title: Split setup from relocation
options.body: Land the Homebrew setup improvements separately while the skill visibility contract receives maintainer review.

recommendation.title: Accept plugin-scoped imsg after fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the ownership move, require the docs mismatch and macOS setup proof to be fixed, and treat inactive-plugin skill loss as intended behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: CONTRIBUTING.md lists @tyler6204 as the iMessage owner, and this decision is about iMessage skill ownership and setup UX.
